title: Lifting a family along an embedding
statement: Let $e$ be an embedding of the $r$ coordinate positions into the $k$ coordinate positions, and let $F$ assign a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$ to each point of the $r$-dimensional cube. Define a family on the $k$-dimensional cube by restricting each input to the coordinates selected by $e$ and then evaluating $F$.
hypotheses_covered: $e$ is an embedding from the $r$ coordinate positions into the $k$ coordinate positions
$F$ is a family indexed by the $r$-dimensional cube, with values in real-valued functions on $\mathbb F_2^n$
